bridgeOverrides: Preserve exact source experience instead of truncating to the start of the level.
Derive Gen III IVs from Gen I DVs with deterministic low bits instead of unrelated random IVs.
Convert Gen I stat experience into a valid proportional Gen III EV spread instead of clearing EVs.

identity.language: English source assumption; record warning if unavailable

pokemon.gender: infer Gen II-compatible gender from species ratio and Attack DV, then constrain PID
pokemon.shiny: preserve source shiny status through PID/TID/SID relation
pokemon.ivs: each Gen I DV doubled plus one deterministic bit; Special feeds both Sp. Atk and Sp. Def
pokemon.evs: ceil square root of stat experience, duplicate Special, proportionally scale to the Gen III 510 total cap
pokemon.moves: map by move name, preserve order and PP Ups, clamp current PP to FireRed maximum
pokemon.pokerus: none unless explicitly decoded by source
